title: Online respiratory exam screenshots - reference collection
note: Twenty-nine preferred screenshot pages from multiple screens; most MCQs overlap the 4 July 2022 paper. The archive already removed nine repeated screenshots from the original 38-page file. Preserved as a reference collection outside default-paper selection. Filled student radio buttons are unofficial supplied selections. The 28 screenshot MCQs reuse the July 2022 canonical question IDs, so combined sessions do not repeat them. Four original short-answer prompts are preserved in downloads.

notes: All 29 preferred pages reviewed visually: 28 MCQs and 4 short-answer prompts on the final page. No exact prompt-and-option repeat remains inside the preferred 29 pages.
The OCR order for options on many screenshot pages was reversed; live options follow visual top-to-bottom order.
Most items repeat July 2022 theory prompts, but source provenance is retained for parent cross-bank deduplication. The four final-page short-answer items are different formats and remain intact.
The source screen title, student names and browser chrome are not reproduced in question prompts.

archive.title: Respiratory system — online-exam screenshot collection
archive.note: 29 distinct page contents from 38 screenshot pages; final mixed prompt page retained. Most MCQs also occur in July 2022, but this collection is not asserted to be that exam. Repeated captures are omitted only from this derivative; all 38 original pages remain in the source PDF. Unconfirmed date, not a separate verified sitting.
